## Serie A 2018/19-2020/21 gap supplement (req-20261003-009)
161 fixture gaps processed. 7 distinct venue coordinate sets resolved via geocoding + Wikipedia/Structurae/OSM cross-check; 5 club lifecycle pairs resolved via Wikipedia (season-debut tables). Every value carries source_url, final_url, fetched_at, field_semantics, evidence_notes. Conflict-prone items (Ciro Vigorito coords, Paolo Mazza lon, Brescia 1929-vs-1965, Benevento/Chievo/SPAL/Crotone founding/refounding years) are documented in conflict_queue, not auto-selected.
Explicitly NOT collected: Qimen, 九宫, 宫位, Q/F/G/I/M, model direction, Miss, odds, Outcome, Review, Gold, any post-match model fields.

rejected_alternative.source: internal geocoder (Via Santa Colomba entrance match)

conflict_queue.note: 4 independent web sources agree within ~40m; internal geocoder was ~0.7km off. Consensus used.

sources: one of 18 original Serie A teams, 1929-30 9th

SPAL 2013 Srl refounded after bankruptcy; club claims 1907 heritage.
FC Crotone Calcio founded 1991 after bankruptcy; club claims 1910 heritage.
